tasks.title: Design and Test Prompts for AI Models

steps.description: Research and gather requirements for the prompt design, including target audience and desired outcomes.
Create a set of initial prompts based on the gathered requirements and existing knowledge bases.
Refine the prompts through iterative testing and feedback, ensuring clarity and effectiveness.
Analyze the performance of the prompts using metrics such as accuracy, fluency, and relevance.
Update and refine the prompts based on the analysis results, incorporating lessons learned and best practices.
Document the prompt design process, including decisions made and trade-offs considered.
Share the refined prompts with the development team for integration into the AI model.
Monitor the performance of the AI model with the new prompts and gather feedback from users.
Continuously update and improve the prompts based on user feedback and emerging trends.
Develop and maintain a knowledge base of effective prompts and design principles.

tasks.title: Develop and Maintain Prompt Engineering Guidelines

steps.description: Research and gather best practices for prompt engineering from industry experts and research papers.
Create a comprehensive set of guidelines for prompt engineering, including design principles and testing methodologies.
Establish a review process for prompt engineering guidelines to ensure they remain up-to-date and effective.
Develop training materials and workshops to educate prompt engineers on the guidelines and best practices.
Create a community of practice for prompt engineers to share knowledge, experiences, and feedback.
Monitor the adoption and effectiveness of the guidelines and make adjustments as needed.
Collaborate with other teams, such as development and product, to ensure alignment and integration of the guidelines.
Develop and maintain a set of metrics to measure the effectiveness of the guidelines and prompt engineering practices.
Continuously update and refine the guidelines based on emerging trends, new research, and user feedback.
Establish a process for recognizing and rewarding outstanding contributions to the prompt engineering community.
Collect and preprocess prompt data, including text, metadata, and performance metrics.
Apply natural language processing techniques to analyze the prompts and identify areas for improvement.
Develop and apply optimization techniques, such as prompt tuning and paraphrasing, to improve prompt performance.
Evaluate the effectiveness of the optimized prompts using metrics such as accuracy, fluency, and relevance.
Refine the optimization techniques based on the evaluation results and incorporate user feedback.
Develop and maintain a set of metrics to measure the effectiveness of the prompt analysis and optimization process.
Create a knowledge base of optimized prompts and design principles to share with the prompt engineering community.
Collaborate with other teams, such as development and product, to ensure alignment and integration of the optimized prompts.
Continuously update and refine the prompt analysis and optimization process based on emerging trends and user feedback.
Develop and maintain a set of tools and scripts to automate the prompt analysis and optimization process.

tasks.title: Develop and Maintain Prompt Engineering Tools

steps.description: Research and gather requirements for prompt engineering tools, including functionality and user experience.
Design and develop prompt engineering tools, such as prompt generators and analyzers, using programming languages and frameworks.
Test and refine the prompt engineering tools to ensure they meet the requirements and are user-friendly.
Deploy and maintain the prompt engineering tools, including updates, bug fixes, and security patches.
Develop and maintain documentation for the prompt engineering tools, including user guides and API documentation.
Provide support and training for users of the prompt engineering tools, including tutorials and workshops.
Collaborate with other teams, such as development and product, to ensure alignment and integration of the prompt engineering tools.
Continuously update and refine the prompt engineering tools based on emerging trends, user feedback, and new research.
Develop and maintain a set of metrics to measure the effectiveness and adoption of the prompt engineering tools.
Establish a process for recognizing and rewarding outstanding contributions to the development and maintenance of the prompt engineering tools.
